_comment: SAMPLE / PROPOSED economy store packs (resource, farming-boost, offline-storage, bundles). Shaped to the real PackDef schema (Assets/_Modules/Wallet/PackCatalog.cs) + the additive extensions specified in WorkOrders/WORK_ORDER_economy_store_packs.md §2/§7: economy.wood/iron/grain, pricing.coins(gold)/crystals(soft), convenience[].boost (BoostSpec), and the optional badge/featured/rotationGroup/category/discountPct flags. This is NOT the live catalogue — do NOT merge into Assets/.../Canonical/packs.json (that holds the canon five). Once the schema extension lands, these append into the catalogue (or a sibling economy-packs.json) and load via PackCatalog. All artId values are PLACEHOLDERS — icons not yet produced (see WO §11). Resource/price numbers are starting points to tune against the harvest economy.

_schemaExtensions.pricing: Adds coins (gold) + crystals (soft currency) in-game price tracks alongside usd/usdc/sol/skr wallet rails. A pack is soft-purchasable when coins>0 or crystals>0; wallet-purchasable when usdc/sol/skr>0.
_schemaExtensions.convenience.boost: Optional nested BoostSpec { multiplier, durationHours, appliesTo(all|wood|iron|grain), stack(extend|refresh|reject|queue) } for timed kinds. Null for non-timed items.
_schemaExtensions.packDef: Optional badge(starter|best-value), featured(bool), rotationGroup(string), category(resource|boost|storage|bundle), discountPct(int).
